evals.prompt: Create a low-poly island scene with palm trees, blue ocean water, and a sunset HDRI. Render it from a slightly elevated camera angle.
evals.expected_output: A rendered image showing a stylized island scene with correct material setup, HDRI environment, and properly framed camera shot.

evals.prompt: I have a default Blender scene. Replace the cube with a glass wine goblet shape using basic primitives and boolean operations. Make it look like actual glass with proper refraction. Render a product shot with studio lighting.
evals.expected_output: A glass-material goblet rendered with studio lighting, visible refraction, caustics enabled, and clean composition.

evals.prompt: Create an animated solar system with the sun at the center (glowing emission), Earth with a blue/green texture, and the moon orbiting Earth. Set up Cycles and render a single frame showing all three bodies.
evals.expected_output: A scene with emission sun, textured Earth, and positioned moon. Proper scale relationships and a rendered frame.
